# Copec's Arauco approves construction of $4.6 bln pulp mill in Brazil

By Reuters

September 25, 2024 12:57 AM UTC Updated September 25, 2024

SANTIAGO, Sept 24 (Reuters) - Chilean pulp and wood panel maker Arauco (ANTCOC.UL) approved the construction of the 'Sucuriu Project' pulp mill in Brazil, parent company Copec said Tuesday in a statement.

The plant will have an investment of $4.6 billion and an annual production capacity of about 3.5 million metric tons of dry cellulose, industrial conglomerate Empresas Copec (COPEC.SN), opens new tab added.

Copec's forestry arm Arauco has been boosted by higher volumes and higher pulp prices, as well as lower unit sales costs of all fibers, according to the latest company earnings report.
